people.role: French artist who exhibited a urinal as art in 1917

events.title: Halloween Nights at Eastern State Penitentiary
events.description: Five haunted houses inside a crumbling 19th-century prison, plus live performers, themed bars and food.
events.why: A real abandoned prison is a better haunted house than anything built for the purpose. Last week of the season.
events.note: Runs on select nights only. Check Eastern State’s calendar for open dates.

events.title: Village Halloween Parade
events.subtitle: Sixth Avenue, from Canal Street north

venue.name: Sixth Avenue
venue.address: Lineup at Sixth Ave & Canal St

events.description: The city’s homemade Halloween parade goes north on Sixth Avenue from Canal Street, rain or shine. Anyone in costume can join the march at the Canal Street lineup.
events.why: You can march in it, not just watch. Line up at Canal Street from about 6:30 pm.
events.note: The northern end of the route is given as 15th or 16th Street.

events.title: NYC Marathon
events.subtitle: Staten Island to Central Park, through all five boroughs
events.description: Tens of thousands of runners cross the Verrazzano and run through Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Manhattan to a finish in Central Park.
events.why: Free to watch and the best mood in the city all year. First Avenue and Fourth Avenue in Brooklyn are loud spots.
events.note: Clocks go back an hour that morning.

events.title: Neil deGrasse Tyson: Take Me to Your Leader

people.name: Neil deGrasse Tyson
people.role: Astrophysicist, director of the Hayden Planetarium and host of StarTalk

events.description: Neil deGrasse Tyson on stage at 92NY with his new talk, Take Me to Your Leader.
events.why: The most entertaining science explainer alive, in a room that seats under a thousand.

events.title: The Moth StorySLAM
events.subtitle: Open-mic true stories, five minutes each
events.description: Anyone can put their name in the hat. Ten names are drawn, each storyteller gets five minutes, no notes, and audience judges score them.
events.why: You never know who gets drawn. Some nights are funnier than any comedy show in town.
events.note: A Manhattan StorySLAM is also listed the same night at Rodney’s on First Avenue.

events.note: The event page lists 4:30 pm. The lectures site lists 5:00 pm.

events.title: Nerd Nite: Sitting
events.subtitle: Three short talks and drinks at Caveat
events.description: This month’s theme is sitting. Talks cover the history of the deck chair, how seating works on mass transit, and world records, one of which involves audience members popping balloons by sitting on them.
events.why: Smart, short talks in a bar, and a chance to set a world record with your backside.

events.title: Spooky Creature Feature
events.subtitle: First Saturday open house at the Wagner Free Institute of Science
events.description: A monthly open house at the Wagner, a natural history museum whose cabinets and lecture hall have barely changed since the 1800s. Visitors are encouraged to come in costume.
events.why: A Victorian science museum, intact, full of specimens in wooden cases. Few people in Philadelphia have been.
events.note: The Wagner’s schedule page says November 6; the event page says Saturday, November 7.

events.title: Eagles vs. Giants
